description: This Java source file defines an exception class named FeaturePropertyNotModifiableException within the package org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.exceptions. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException, representing an error condition where a feature property on a thing cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions or other issues. The class includes static factory methods, a nested builder class for constructing instances, and relevant metadata and constants related to the exception.
